headline: Wednesday demand down, but still above similar‑temp days
summary: Peak demand reached 103,861 MWh at 6 PM with a temperature of 74 °F, while average demand was 91,579 MWh. Demand was 14.5% below the same weekday average over the past four weeks and 11.6% below the prior 7‑day average. However, it was 3.5% above days with similar temperatures. The peak ranks 216th out of 365 days.
